scope: Continuous radius-two one-face diagnostic with its explicitly constructed potential V=E+kappa Delta(psi)/psi, retained Haar constant and integral. This potential is not the Wilson potential. Independent finite-character diagnostics retain all original covariance factors and complex coefficients. No numerical YM vacuum or gap conclusion.
